thread:
Maria S: heads up — Starlake reported a p99 jump for the embeddings endpoint (baseline ~2.1s -> ~9.5s) starting ~2024-12-05 22:10 UTC. Customer seeing intermittent timeouts. CS ticket open. Can eng triage? cc @Alex H @Ben P
Alex H: on it. tenant id? any recent reservations/changes?
Maria S: tenant=stl-92. No manual reservation changes from CS. Usage shows a burst of small bulk-embed jobs around 22:05 (lots of concurrent 10-20 item batches).
Ben P: looking at infra metrics — host-gpu-17 has sustained high p95 IO and a handful of pods with big KV cache churn. Looks like a noisy neighbor + queue buildup on the shard serving stl-92. Per-tenant enqueue latency spike visible.
Alex H: can we do a quick mitigation — add stl-92 to priority lane / ephemeral reservation while we root cause?
Ben P: will add ephemeral reservation for 30m. Command I used: ```rdwctl reservations add --tenant stl-92 --ttl 30m --priority high --reason "prod p99 mitigation"```
ops-bot: Reservation created by Ben P — id=rsv-7843 (expires in 00:30:00)
Maria S: customer reports improved response times within 5m — p99 back down to ~1.8s. They're still nervous; asked for a short RCA and next steps. :relieved:
Alex H: good. Follow-ups: 1) identify noisy pods and patch auto-placement to avoid co-locating heavy KV churn tenants; 2) revisit per-tenant throttles (soft limit currently allows large concurrent batch ingestion); 3) add alert for per-tenant queue depth > 20 to catch earlier. I'll file ENG ticket.
Ben P: filed INF-4821 with initial notes and graphs. Also added a short runbook entry under the ticket: - when p99 spike for one tenant, check host-level KV churn + dequeue rates; - if host saturated, add ephemeral reservation or move shard; - temporary priority lane → rsv, command above.
Maria S: noted, forwarding the mitigation steps and reservation id to the customer. They requested guidance for SLA credit flow — will open billing follow-up.
Alex H: long-term fix items on INF-4821: auto-evict hot KV keys, better shard spreading, and conservative early-reject thresholds for >5 items batch.
Ben P: also recommending a short-term config change: set embeddings batch-size cap per-tenant to 5 for noisy tenants. We'll test on staging before flip.
Maria S: thanks team — customer very happy with the quick handoff. I'll close CS ticket once billing & RCA are documented. :thumbsup:
